description: Three-stage Australian native-bird Sankey. Each ribbon corresponds to a full habitat-diet-lifestyle triplet; equal width at both stages. Prepared from Australian_Bird_Data_Version_1 and AVONET1_BirdLife.

fillOpacity.signal: focusHabitat !== 'All habitats' && datum.habitat !== focusHabitat ? 0.035 : hoverTriplet !== null ? (datum.key === hoverTriplet ? 0.93 : 0.055) : hoverNode !== null ? (datum[hoverNode.stage] === hoverNode.name ? 0.78 : 0.052) : 0.40

tooltip.signal: datum.name + ': ' + datum.count + ' species (' + format(100 * datum.count / 627, '.1f') + '% of included species)'

stroke.signal: hoverNode !== null && datum.stage === hoverNode.stage && datum.name === hoverNode.name ? '#273729' : '#f7f4ed'

strokeWidth.signal: hoverNode !== null && datum.stage === hoverNode.stage && datum.name === hoverNode.name ? 2 : 0.5

usermeta.source: Australian_Bird_Data_Version_1(1).xlsx / Australian Bird Data; AVONET Supplementary dataset 1.xlsx / AVONET1_BirdLife
usermeta.scope: Core, species-level, living, non-introduced, non-vagrant, non-supplementary taxa; no non-breeding population duplicates. Conservative exact scientific-name join.
